title: Bigstacks
description: This project adds customizable item stack sizes, allowing players to store more items in a single inventory slot.
body:
Вот перевод на английский:

**BigStacks** is a mod for NeoForge 1.21.1 that increases the stack size of items in the inventory.

It removes the default limit of 64 items per stack and allows you to configure the maximum stack size through a config file or with the `/bigstacks` command.

After entering the command, a settings menu opens where you can:

* Enable or disable increased stack sizes
* Choose the maximum stack size (for example, 128, 256, or higher)
* Configure custom rules for specific items

**Important:**
This mod does not work on servers!
